author_reading_scope: Read the complete relevant reasoning in Dao et al. §§2.2–3.1, Appendix B.2–B.4, and the full Appendix C proof of Theorem 1; read Milakov–Gimelshein §§2–3 and the complete induction proof of Theorem 1; and read MIT OCW 18.S096 Chapter 8 §§8.3–8.3.1 in the complete 102-page lecture-note PDF. The local empty-state convention avoids the undefined first merge from a -infinity sentinel on an empty masked block. The local backward proof derives the VJP and freezes maximum shifts; it does not differentiate through a tied maximum. The FlashAttention HBM theorem and endpoint lower-bound argument are recorded as out of scope for this scalar workspace claim.
